# Jellyscale contract fixtures

Recorded from Jellyscale pinned at `b920b193cd6f7835dec70198477a07216118b34d` (`x-jellyscale-commit` in
`tests/integration/docker-compose.yml`), built from the public source. The fixtures live in `<12 hex>/`.

## The fixture server (T2-08, 2026-11-21)

- Compose built the image from the commit fragment of the Git URL context (no buildx fallback needed). The image label
  `org.opencontainers.image.revision` holds the full commit. Cold build plus start: about 33 s on the dev machine.
  CI has no build cache; the `tripwire` job's 30-minute timeout is far from this.
- The samples (mode 644, made by the host user) are readable by the container's uid 1000.
- With the samples generated by `pnpm samples:generate`, Jellyscale listed 15 items: 11 videos in Movies and 3 in Shows
  (plus the Synthetic Show series). Movies: Synthetic ASS, AV1, Extras, Extras Featurette (the featurette file),
  H264, HEVC HDR10, Multitrack, Sidecar, Versions twice (its 1080p and 720p files, as two items, not one item with two
  sources), and the BluRay folder as one item named `00000` (its `BDMV/STREAM/00000.m2ts`; Jellyscale logged a failed
  frame extraction for it). The Extras trailer file was not listed as an item. Shows: S00E01 (the special), S01E01 and S01E02.
  No ISO sample exists in the default sample set.
- The first scan finished in under 10 s.
